notes: Tuition facts: The DAAD page states 500 EUR/semester tuition for non-EU applicants, but the DIT pages (th-deg.de) state "No tuition fees, only student union fee" and instead charge a 500 EUR/semester service fee for non-EU/EEA students. This is presented as a service fee, not tuition. The applicant should verify with the university whether these are the same or separate charges. No application deadlines could be reliably extracted: the programme page (th-deg.de/ain-b-en) states "Application period April 15 – June 15" but does not specify the year; the DAAD page states the same period without a year. No documents list was found on the pages that specifically applies to this programme for international applicants; the th-deg.de/en/apply page provides a general list that matches the format requested. No prior study years requirement was stated on the pages. No subject requirements were stated for this programme specifically.

note.fr: Test d'admission en ligne obligatoire (mathématiques, logique, informatique) + essai de 200 à 300 mots ; prévu en mai/juin. Vérifier les modalités auprès de l'université.
note.en: Compulsory online admission test (mathematics, logic, computer science) + essay of 200 to 300 words; expected in May/June. Check details with the university.

evidence.quote: Admission is based on a combination of the required university entrance qualification (document verification via anabin) and an admission test.

note.fr: Aucune condition d'admission générale de fin d'études secondaires n'est précisée pour cette formation ; vérifier si un diplôme du secondaire suffit ou si le programme exige des mathématiques ou des matières spécifiques.
note.en: No general admission requirement for secondary school leaving certificate is stated for this programme; check whether a secondary school diploma is sufficient or if the programme requires specific subjects like mathematics.
